children: Director Michael Robert Stone reported purchasing 40,000 shares through Ptolemy Capital, LLC on November 24, 2026, at a weighted average price of $15.7406 per share; 40,000 shares through Ptolemy Capital, LLC on November 25 at $15.7812 per share; and 20,000 shares through Ptolemy Capital, LLC on November 27 at $17.053 per share. The total purchase amount was $1,601,932. Following the transactions, Stone directly owned 8,213 shares and indirectly owned 2,042,324 shares and 1,892,994 shares through Ptolemy Capital, LLC, and 169,330 shares through The Michael and Karen Stone Family Foundation, Inc.
